reading.title: Learning from a Loss
reading.text: Last month my basketball team suffered a heavy defeat. We lost 60-24 against a much stronger team. After the match some players were angry, but our coach asked us to accept defeat politely. We shook hands with the other players and congratulated them. In the evening the coach explained that every defeat teaches something new. We watched the game on video and saw our mistakes. Since then we have practised more, and in the next match we lost by only two points. It was still a defeat, but a narrow one, and we felt proud of our progress.
